caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a shallow bowl with an ornate handle. The bowl is rendered in shades of yellow and brown, with darker accents indicating shading and the contours of the bowl. The handle is elaborately designed, curling upward and ending in a decorative loop with a small hanging element. The interior of the bowl includes several dark lines and shapes that suggest details or ornamentation. The bowl is placed on a lightly shaded surface, which provides a sense of grounding. The drawing itself is centered within a larger, plain, light beige or cream-colored background, and appears to be executed with pencil or graphite and some colored pigment. The main area of focus is the bowl, with no other objects or background details present in the composition.
title: Pottery
